description: A version range the adapter can satisfy: it negotiates 1, declares its manifest, and answers a health probe over a recorded corpus. The manifest is where most of this adapter's argument lives — indexed rather than live because Clara rewrites these files in place, as_of none because they carry no revision history, and the sensitivity floor of the signals store set to internal to match the sources it projects. Health names the store this instance OPENED under store_identity, which is what lets `recall doctor` refuse a profile where two instances read one store. recall/refresh then rebuilds the projection and returns gen-2: this adapter owns an index, so a refresh does real work and says so, rather than reporting a generation it did not build.

placeholders.FIXTURE: absolute path of this case's fixture/ directory
placeholders.WORKDIR: absolute path of a fresh, writable, empty directory
